description: Evaluates a business-for-sale listing (Acquire.com, Flippa, broker) against EvalyMe's model: valuation range, whether the asking price is below, within, or above it, and the asking price as a multiple of ARR and of profit. Accepts the figures a listing states; any figure not supplied gets a documented neutral default, reported in `assumptions`. Yearly growth and annual churn are converted to compounded monthly rates. Evaluates one listing per call.

activeCustomers.description: Active or paying customers, if the listing states them.

ageMonths.description: Business age in months, e.g. 36 for '3 years old'.

annualChurnPercent.description: Annual churn as a percent. Converted to a compounded monthly rate.

annualRevenue.description: Annual revenue in USD (ARR, TTM, or last-12-months). Used only when monthlyRevenue is absent.

askingPrice.description: Asking price in USD; absent for unpriced or 'make an offer' listings.

listingUrl.description: The listing's URL, echoed back in the result for matching. Never fetched.

monetization.description: Primary revenue model. 'SaaS Subscription' for recurring software; 'Marketplace' for commission/take-rate businesses; 'Advertising' for ad-funded content; 'One-time Purchase' for ecommerce, templates, or lifetime deals; 'Freemium' for free tiers that convert to paid; 'Services' for agencies and productized services.

monthlyChurnPercent.description: Monthly churn as a percent. Takes precedence over annualChurnPercent.

monthlyGrowthPercent.description: Month-over-month revenue growth as a percent. Takes precedence over yearlyGrowthPercent.

monthlyProfit.description: Average monthly net profit or SDE in USD. Used only for the asking-price profit multiple; the valuation model is revenue-based.

monthlyRevenue.description: Monthly revenue in USD (MRR or average monthly revenue). Takes precedence over annualRevenue.

yearlyGrowthPercent.description: Year-over-year revenue growth as a percent, e.g. 40 means +40% YoY. Converted to a compounded monthly rate.

name: analyze_listing

assumptions.description: Every value EvalyMe assumed, derived, or capped. Empty when all inputs were supplied.

engineVersion.description: Model version; results with the same version and inputs are identical.

impliedMultipleOnArr.description: Range midpoint divided by ARR. Absent when ARR is 0.

investorScore.description: 0-100 operating score from six weighted signals.

askingVsMidPercent.description: How far the asking price sits above (+) or below (-) the model midpoint, in percent.

modelInput.description: The exact inputs the engine used.

priorities.description: Up to three weakest weighted signals, each with one concrete next step.

saveToEvalyMeUrl.description: Opens this estimate in the EvalyMe app so the user can save, track, and improve it.

title: Analyze a business-for-sale listing
